Name: Better Trash Can
Author: shivaGuy
Description:
[b]Better Trash Can[/b] improves the reclamation price when trashing an item.

It changes the default reclamation percentages for progression of [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Trash_Cans]Trash Cans[/url].
You can also change the progression mode from "Linear" to "Exponential" in the mod's config.json

[b][u]Reference Table:
[/u][/b]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/11814/11814-1650978231-147686732.png[/img]

[size=5][b][u]Installation
[/u][/b][/size]
1. Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url].
2. Unzip the mod folder into Stardew Valley/Mods
3. Run the game using SMAPI.

[i]Note that this mod will not change the description message ("when trashing and item, you reclaim XX% of the value.") in the clint shop when buying Trash Can updrade since it is hard-coded in the menu system of the game.[/i]
[b][u]
[/u][/b][u][b][size=5]Technical Details[/size][/b][/u]

This mod uses Harmony to patch the game code.
